entities.title: Workflows
entities.summary: The GitHub Actions that test every pull request and check its database changes; nothing here deploys.
entities.purpose: Holds the workflows and their scripts: ci.yml validates the .dev diagrams and knowledge files and tests and builds each game a pull request changes; game.yml is one game's test and build that ci.yml calls, with a deploy step nothing calls any more; migrations.yml is the Database migration check on pull requests. scripts/ lists the changed games (leaving .dev files out) and runs the migration gate.
boundaries: Each game's pipeline, as it applies to that game, is described in that game's .dev/pipeline.json; this folder's pipeline.json describes the workflows themselves and links to them.
No workflow deploys: the Deploy workflow was removed (2026-11-21), and the owner deploys each game from their own machine with npm run deploy in its folder.
Production database migrations are applied by hand, outside these workflows.
